digest.component_or_area: LLM gate verdict assembly and signing
propositions: Signed gate verdicts record only a model string and cannot distinguish between verdicts produced by different providers (e.g., Bedrock vs Anthropic) or tiers, even though rebar signs both

A new sibling object provider_provenance must be added to verdict payloads containing provider, model, endpoint_host, tier, and capabilities to enable consumers to identify and optionally reject off-tier verdicts

The endpoint_host field must extract only the hostname via urlparse().hostname to exclude credentials, with a test asserting neither username, password, nor api_key appears in the persisted sidecar payload
The change must be additive and backward-compatible so older readers ignore the new key, legacy payloads load successfully, and signatures over existing manifests remain valid
Provenance must be assembled once per run in capabilities.py using primitives only, reusing the capability record already computed at runner.py:357 rather than recomputing to prevent divergence

The provider_provenance record must be threaded through all three gate verdict assembly paths (plan_review/orchestrator.py, code_review finalize, completion_reconcile) and persisted by all three sidecars
